title: Bounded private-provider metadata admission

trigger.observation: Both initialization failures stop with authority-busy before their expected provider creation observations. Static phase diagnostics locate them in provider initialization, not native return execution. A sample captures repeated private provider read/authority resolution. Exact contention incidence remains load-dependent.

implementation: Store private_provider_read(context, AuthorityWait) queues metadata work for SQL/authority on a blocking worker and repeats current authorization, exact physical/private selection, complete audience and content checks under the resulting owned fence.
The immediate try_private_provider_read API shares the same final validation. Packet/media callbacks retain their existing immediate admission.

Server creation/export reads use one original five-second preflight deadline, cancellation-linked AuthorityWait and timeout. Late blocking completions cannot start IO. Creation/export begin tokens, actual network calls and captured observations are not retried.

store_verification.scope: Private provider and related observation/cleanup tests. New SQL-queue test verifies current revocation refusal after waiting; canceled admission cannot mark creation/export started.

earlier_parallel_store_run.observation: Includes expired/unauthorized, forbidden and bounded authority-busy failures. The serial result does not qualify this parallel load. No credential lifetime, wait bound or runtime profile was increased.

initial_compile_attempt.result: New test accessed the private context delivery field; corrected to the existing delivery_id accessor.

production_verification.meaning: Both previously authority-busy provider initialization cases now pass in the unchanged-bound cohort. All8 original provider/record/cancel/retention-return cases pass. The sole failure is the separately recorded missing existing-media credential rebind. This is not a full G6-046 or a general load/retention-return reliability claim.

remaining: Default parallel Store qualification remains unresolved; the serial/current bounded production result does not override the29-pass/7-failure parallel run.
The two earlier retention/primary-return refusals remain unresolved; queued initialization reads are not a proven fix for that historical return predicate.
Existing native media credential rebind still fails its new production test; owned step-up, cross-substrate DTMF and all61 clause qualification remain open.

build_verification.warnings: Existing upstream dead/private-interface and linker unwind-table warnings remain recorded.

native_credential_refresh_continuation.meaning: The previously failing existing-media refresh path now passes explicit Store epoch/Core revision checks, successor DTMF send/receive and independently decoded RTP after original expiry for both signing algorithms. Earlier results remain historical; full G6-046 and broader profiles remain open.
